name: Yampa River — Deerlodge Park and Yampa Canyon
gaugeName: Yampa River at Deerlodge Park, CO (USGS 09260050)
blurb: Lower Yampa into Dinosaur National Monument: the approach to Deerlodge Park and the permitted multi-day Yampa Canyon trip to Split Mountain, UT.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Mileage: CPW Yampa River State Park river sections.

notices.title: Deerlodge takeout permit
notices.text: NPS requires a play permit for trips entering from above Deerlodge and taking out there. Contact the River Permit Office to confirm arrangements; NPS recommends arriving after 2 pm to avoid congestion. Continuing below Deerlodge requires the appropriate canyon trip permit.
notices.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)

putInAccess.note: CPW AdminData facilities (FeatureServer/0), feature 5192 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 48 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM-owned site managed by CPW (CPW GIS feature comment); boating access documented by CPW Yampa River State Park (West Cross Mountain is a river access site, 9 miles above Deerlodge Park). (CPW Yampa River State Park river sections, https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/yampa-river-state-park/yampa-river-state-park-river-sections). Imagery check 2026-10-26 (Esri World Imagery + USGS NHDPlus HR): Location passes: pin at the end of the dirt access road at the water's edge (HR polygon offset 28 m). Facility conflict: no built ramp visible; CPW park page says 'Boat Ramp: None' and NPS-managed, CPW GIS says BLM ramp managed by CPW. Published as 'Boat launch' (not ramp).

takeOutAccess.note: NPS Public POIs (FeatureServer/0), feature 9798 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 69 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: NPS launch. Launching for the Yampa Canyon needs a Dinosaur NM river permit (Recreation.gov 250014). Taking out here after floating from above Deerlodge (e.g. West Cross Mountain) needs a free NPS one-day 'play permit' (NPS boating page, checked 2026-10-26). (NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26), https://www.nps.gov/dino/planyourvisit/boating-and-rafting.htm).

sections.notes: NPS river permit required for all trips (Recreation.gov 250014). Warm Springs rapid. Take-out is in Utah. Mileage: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating in the Monument' 2025.

guideTimes.conditions: NPS normal permitted high-use-season trip length (5 days/4 nights); an itinerary allocation, not hours afloat; overlength by one day only on rare occasions
guideTimes.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating in the Monument' 2025

notices.title: Dinosaur river permit
notices.text: A river permit is required for the Yampa Canyon trip. Check NPS and Recreation.gov for the applicable season, lottery dates, fees and trip-length limits.

notices.title: Permit
notices.text: NPS: play permits are required for boating upstream of the Gates of Lodore or Deerlodge Park boat ramps and for downstream travel from the Split Mountain Boat Ramp; groups launching above Deerlodge must stop at Deerlodge for boater check-in before continuing on a permitted trip.
notices.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)

takeOutAccess.sourceName: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 4808 'Split Mountain Boat Launch' (DINO)
takeOutAccess.note: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 4808 'Split Mountain Boat Launch' (DINO) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: NPS Dinosaur NM: Boating and Rafting Permits (https://www.nps.gov/dino/planyourvisit/boating-and-rafting.htm): 'Green River multiday permits start at Gates of Lodore Boat Ramp and end at Split Mountain Boat Ramp.' Daily section 'from Rainbow Park to the Split Mountain Boat Ramp'. Conditions page: Split Mountain Road open. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/split_mountain_boat_ramp.png): the point is on the concrete ramp apron at the water. NHD flowline 38 m away.
